# printer.cfg for printer_v4: GENERATED by mechloop from the electrical model. Do not edit by hand;

[mcu]
serial: /dev/ttyAMA0
restart_method: command

[printer]
kinematics: cartesian
max_velocity: 250
max_accel: 4000
max_z_velocity: 12
max_z_accel: 200

[stepper_x]
step_pin: PB13
dir_pin: !PB12
enable_pin: !PB14
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PC0
position_endstop: 0
position_min: 0
position_max: 180
homing_speed: 50

uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 0
run_current: 0.280
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

step_pin: PB0
dir_pin: PC5
enable_pin: !PB1
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PC1
position_endstop: 0
position_min: 0
position_max: 180
homing_speed: 50

uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 1
run_current: 1.200
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_z]

dir_pin: !PB2
enable_pin: !PB11
microsteps: 16

position_max: 153.100
homing_speed: 5

[tmc2209 stepper_z]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 2
run_current: 0.280
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

microsteps: 16
